title: Bapt christian community
author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

chapters.title: Congregatio pro Doctrina Fidei — Notificatio
paras: Quaesitum est ab hac Congregatione pro Doctrina Fidei, utrum baptismus collatus apud communitatem vulgo dictam « Christian Community » vel « Die Christengemeinschaft » domini Rodulfi Steiner validus sit an non.
Haec Congregatio, diligenti examine expleto, respondendum decrevit: Negative.
